features: Logitech’s first mouse with palm cushion: The built-in palm cushion on the contoured mouse gives you a comfy spot for your hand making long hours of work feel a little more comfortable
Feel a natural, confident fit: Shaped for right-handed users with most hand sizes, this comfortable mouse with cozy side grips helps you stay relaxed and in control, hour after hour
Scroll faster, stay focused: Scroll line by line or fly through pages with SmartWheel; quiet clicks reduce noise in shared or home offices
Make it yours: Customizable buttons via Logi Options+ adapt to your tasks and help you do more; in the app you can boost productivity across apps, adjust DPI levels and personalize your workflow.
Simple connections: Connect this multi-device mouse with Bluetooth pairing, then swap up to 3 devices instantly with Easy-Switch—just a tap, no dongle needed; perfect for multitasking
